caseName: Florida ex rel. Yoeman v. City of Sarasota
caseNameFull: Florida ex rel. Yoeman v. City of Sarasota and Florida ex rel. Garland v. Same
attorneys: Messrs. Stuart B. Warren, George W. Wylie, and J. Velma Keen for appellants., Messrs. J. J. Williams, Jr. and Francis C. Dart for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeals are dismissed for the reason that the judgments of the state court are based upon a non-federal ground adequate to support them. Farson, Son & Co. v. Bird, 248 U. S. 268, 271; Doyle v. Atwell, 261 U. S. 590; McCoy v. Shaw, 277 U. S. 302.
